name: Peep.txt
tagline: Audits one URL the way AI crawlers see it and drafts an llms.txt patch list
description: Reads one public website the way an AI crawler would and hands over what to fix: an llms.txt draft, additions for robots.txt, notes on schema, and a patch list of five items. Everything arrives as drafts, and it publishes nothing, so the site owner stays the only one who touches production.
author: Eric
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
